mfa.title: Verify it's you

instructions.totp: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app.
instructions.email: We can email you a 6-digit code. Enter it below.
instructions.recovery: Enter one of the recovery codes you saved when you set up verification.

mfa.emailSent: A code was sent to your email address.

use.email: Use a code sent by email

enrol.title: Set up two-step verification
enrol.description: Your organisation requires a second step when you sign in. Choose how you want to receive codes.

setup.totpIntro: Use an authenticator app such as Microsoft Authenticator or Google Authenticator.
setup.totpStep1: Open your authenticator app and add an account.
setup.totpStep2: Scan the QR code, or type the key below.
setup.totpStep3: Enter the 6-digit code the app shows.
setup.qrAlt: QR code for your authenticator app
setup.emailIntro: We will send a code to your work email each time you sign in.

recovery.title: Save your recovery codes
recovery.description: Each code works once if you lose access to your authenticator app or email. They are shown only now.

forgot.title: Reset your password
forgot.description: Enter your user name or email. If an account exists, we will email a link to reset the password.
forgot.sentDescription: If an account matches, a link is on its way. It is valid for 60 minutes.

reset.title: Choose a new password
reset.done: Your password is set. You can sign in now.

errors.invalidCredentials: The user name or password is incorrect.
errors.lockedOut: This account is locked after too many failed attempts. Try again later or ask an administrator.
errors.invalidCode: The code is not valid. Check it and try again.
errors.mfaExpired: The verification step expired. Please sign in again.
errors.methodNotAvailable: This verification method is not available.
errors.mfaRequiredByPolicy: Your organisation requires two-step verification for your account, so you cannot turn off the last method.
errors.mfaNotEnabled: Two-step verification is not turned on.
errors.totpAlreadyEnabled: An authenticator app is already set up. Turn it off first to set up a new one.
errors.resetTokenInvalid: This link is invalid or has expired. Ask for a new one.
errors.interactiveOnly: This can only be done in a signed-in browser session, not with an access token.
errors.tokenScope: This access token does not allow this action.
errors.externalFailed: Sign-in with the external provider did not complete. Try again.
errors.externalNoMatch: Your external account is not linked to an employee of this organisation. Contact your administrator.
errors.externalNoAccount: You do not have an account in this system yet. Contact your administrator.
errors.externalUserType: This type of UAE Pass account cannot sign in here.
